newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina La Rioja mine tender extended to Oct 22.
newsitem.headline: Argentina La Rioja mine tender extended to Oct 22.

text.p: Argentina's northwestern province of La Rioja has extended until October 22 the deadline for bids in a tender for a 32,700-hectare gold prospecting area, the provincial government's top mining official said.
The deadline was extended from August 23 at the request of interested companies, La Rioja's mining director Juan Carlos Sacco told Reuters.
The Sierra de las Minas y Ulapes area in the extreme south of the province holds gold veins contained in quartz with grades from 12 to 17 grams a tonne.
Six sets of tender specifications have been sold so far, to companies from Chile, Peru, Argentina, Mexico, Australia and Canada, Sacco said.
La Rioja already has one fair-sized gold project, Famatina, being developed in the center of the province by Anglo-Australian mining giant RTZ Plc-CRA Ltd.
